subject: English
question_text: Make five sentences using parts of sentences from each column of the table below. 1  5 =
stimulus: Poverty live low life expectancy and illiteracy Deprivation of the basic human needs widespread and hunger is often deadly in this country 8 hundred million people probably the universal definition of poverty There is under acute poverty in Bangladesh The consequences of it are three dimensions of poverty : social, economic and political
guide_solution: (a) Poverty is widespread and hunger is often deadly in this country. (b) Deprivation of the basic human needs is probably the universal definition of poverty. (c) 8 hundred million people live under acute poverty in Bangladesh. (d) There are three dimensions of poverty; social, economic and political. (e) The consequences of it are low life expectancy and illiteracy.
